notes: CDER letter following an on-site inspection of an OTC topical drug manufacturer, citing failure to investigate water-system OOS/OOL microbial and chemical results, inadequate component identity testing (methanol/DEG/EG contamination risk), lack of process validation, unvalidated microbiological test methods, and an ineffective quality unit. Recovered microorganisms were explicitly not identified to genus/species ('Your investigations did not include identification of the recovered microorganisms'), so organisms is empty. Specific product/component names are redacted as (b)(4), so products is empty. Letter also notes some products may be regulated as cosmetics, but no drug product names are given in clear text.
